title: The Lion's Story
situation: 어제 읽은 동화의 결말을 친구에게 들려준다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: What happened to the little Mouse?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: The Lion laughed but let the Mouse go.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Oh, good! I like that.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Me too! The Mouse was very brave.

title: Waking Up Early
situation: 아침에 못 일어난다는 친구에게 속담을 인용해 조언한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I always get up late. It's hard.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: The early bird catches the worm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: You're right. I'll try tomorrow.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Great! You can do it.

title: Words and Actions
situation: 말만 하고 안 지키는 사람 얘기를 듣고 답한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: He says sorry, but he's late again.
turns.text_kr: 그 사람은 미안하다고 하면서 또 늦어요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Actions speak louder than words.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: True. He needs to change.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes. Talking is easy.

title: My Family Picture
situation: 친구에게 가족사진을 보여주며 가족을 소개한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Oh, nice picture! Who are they?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: This is my family.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Wow! Is that your mother?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! Is your family big?

title: About My Family
situation: 새로 만난 사람과 가족 이야기를 한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Do you have any brothers?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I have one brother and one sister.
turns.text_kr: 저는 남동생 한 명과 여동생 한 명이 있어요.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Nice! Do they live here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: My sister does. My brother doesn't.

title: Practice Every Day
situation: 영어가 늘지 않는다고 걱정하는 친구에게 말한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: My English isn't good yet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Practice makes perfect.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: So I need more time?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! Speak a little every day.

title: No Bad Questions
situation: 새로 온 동료에게 일을 알려 준다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: This job is new to me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Ask anything. There are no bad questions.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Okay. How do I start?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: First, read this. I'll help you.

title: Late but Okay
situation: 숙제를 늦게 시작해 미안해하는 친구를 안심시킨다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I'm starting my homework so late.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Better late than never.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Thanks! I'll finish it today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Good. Don't worry about it.

title: Talking About Pets
situation: 새 친구와 동물 이야기를 하다가 애완동물을 묻는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I love animals so much.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Do you have any pets?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Yes, I have a dog and a cat.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Wow! I want a dog too.

title: In English Class
situation: 수업 중에 물건 이름을 영어로 뭐라고 하는지 묻는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Do you have a question?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: How do you say this in English?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: That's a chair. Can you say it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: A chair. Thanks! You're a good teacher.

title: Meeting a Classmate
situation: 새 수업 첫날 옆자리 사람과 인사를 나눈다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Hi there! What's your name?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Hello, my name is Kim. Nice to meet you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I'm Ann. I'm a student here too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Great! Can we sit together?

title: Time to Wake Up
situation: 늦잠 자는 동생을 아침에 깨운다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Is it morning already? I'm so tired.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Wake up! It's a great day!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Okay, okay. Why are you so happy?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's sunny! Let's go outside.

title: Morning Routine
situation: 친구와 아침에 몇 시에 일어나는지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: You're always early. What time do you wake up?
turns.text_kr: 항상 일찍 오시네요. 몇 시에 일어나요?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I wake up at 7 o'clock every morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: That's early! I get up at nine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Really? Do you go to bed early?

title: After Dinner
situation: 저녁 먹고 나서 보통 뭘 하는지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: What do you usually do at night?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I turn on the TV after dinner.
turns.text_kr: 저는 저녁 식사 후에 TV를 켜요.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Me too! What do you watch?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: A movie. Do you like movies?

title: A Sunny Day
situation: 창밖 날씨를 보며 오늘 뭘 할지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: How's the weather outside?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's sunny and warm today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Nice! Let's go for a walk.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Great! Can we go now?

title: Rain Tomorrow
situation: 내일 비가 그칠지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Will the rain stop tomorrow?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: You never know what will happen tomorrow.
turns.text_kr: 내일 무슨 일이 있을지는 아무도 몰라요.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: True. So let's take umbrellas.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! Mine is in my bag.

title: Lunch at Noon
situation: 점심 시간을 맞춰 같이 먹기로 한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: What time do you eat lunch?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I eat lunch at noon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Me too! Let's eat together.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Great! See you at noon.

title: A Real Friend
situation: 아플 때 도와준 친구 이야기를 듣고 답한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Mina helped me all week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: She's a good friend, really.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes. You have a good friend.

title: Rainy Morning
situation: 비 오는 날 나가는 가족에게 우산을 챙기라고 말한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I'm going to work now. Bye!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Don't forget your umbrella!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Oh, thanks! Is it raining?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes, take mine. It's by the door.
turns.text_kr: 네, 제 것 가져가요. 문 옆에 있어요.

title: Just Start
situation: 배우기를 망설이는 친구에게 시작하라고 한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I want to learn English, but it's hard.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Start now. You'll learn along the way.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Okay. Where do I begin?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Just say hello every day.

title: Asking the Way
situation: 길에서 지나가는 사람에게 역 가는 길을 묻는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Yes? Can I help you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: How do I get to the station?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Go straight and turn right.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Straight and right. Thank you!

title: A Rainy Day
situation: 나가려다 창밖에 오는 비를 본다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Are we going out now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's raining cats and dogs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Really? Then let's watch a movie.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! I'll make some tea.

title: At the Store
situation: 가게에서 물건이 어느 쪽에 있는지 알려준다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Do you have milk here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's on the right side.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: The right side? Thank you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes. Can you see it?

title: Finding the Post Office
situation: 처음 온 동네에서 우체국을 찾다가 도움을 받는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: You look lost. Can I help you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I'm looking for the post office.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: It's near the bank. I'll show you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Thank you so much! Let's go.

title: Many Ways
situation: 친구와 푼 방법이 달라서 걱정한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I did it a different way.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: All roads lead to Rome.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: So my answer is okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! Your answer is right.

title: Near the Bank
situation: 병원이 어디 있는지 묻는 사람에게 위치를 알려준다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Excuse me, where is the hospital?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's next to the bank.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Which bank? The big one?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes, that one. Do you see it?

title: Across from the Park
situation: 친구에게 자주 가는 카페가 어디인지 알려준다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Where is your favorite coffee shop?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's across from the park.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: The big park? I know it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! Do you want to go?

title: Closing Time
situation: 문 닫는 가게 앞에서 내일 다시 오겠다고 말한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Sorry, we're closed now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I'll come back tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: We open at ten. See you!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Okay! I'll be here at ten.

title: Coming Home
situation: 여행 중인 친구에게 언제 돌아오는지 묻는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: I'm in Paris now. It's beautiful!
turns.text_kr: 저 지금 파리에 있어요. 정말 아름다워요!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: When will you go back home?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Next Sunday. I want to see you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Me too! Let's eat at my house.

title: On the Phone
situation: 전화로 지금 출발한다고 알린다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Hi! Are you coming now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I'm getting in the car.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Great! See you soon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Ten minutes. Do you need anything?

title: Calling Family
situation: 가족과 얼마나 자주 연락하는지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Do you talk to your family often?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I call my mother every night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Every night? That's really nice.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes. Do you call your parents?

title: New Food Here
situation: 낯선 나라 음식 앞에서 망설이는 친구에게 말한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: The food here is really different.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Okay! I'll try the new food.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Great. You'll like it.

title: Lost in Town
situation: 낯선 거리에서 길을 잃고 도움을 청한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Excuse me, are you okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I'm lost. Where am I?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: This is Green Street. Where are you going?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: The train station. Thank you!

title: How Far Is It
situation: 버스 정류장 위치를 듣고 얼마나 먼지 묻는다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: The bus stop is over there.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: How far is it from here?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Only five minutes on foot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Thanks! I'll walk then.

title: Going to School
situation: 학교까지 얼마나 걸리는지 이야기한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: How long does it take to get to school?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: It's about 10 minutes by bus.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: That's fast! Do you like the bus?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Yes! It's easy and fast.

title: Saying Goodbye
situation: 여행 떠나는 친구를 배웅한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: My flight is at six. I'm going now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Have a nice trip!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Thank you! I'll call you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Okay! Come back soon!

title: Good Night
situation: 밤늦게까지 있다가 자러 가겠다고 말한다

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: It's late. Are you okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: I'm tired. I want to go to bed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text_en: Okay. Good night, sleep well.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text_en: Thanks. See you tomorrow.
